# Town of Halifax municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 10; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the ELECTED OFFICERS table seats Edee Edwards (Chair) to 2028, Rhonda Ashcraft to 2027, and Lori Marchegiani to 2027.

Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return re-elects Randy Pike to a three-year term (124 votes) and Karen Christofferson to a two-year term (114).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Halifax's five selectboard members as Rhonda Ashcraft, Karen Christofferson, Edee Edwards, Lori Marchegiani, and Randy Pike -- concordant.
Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return elects Paul G. Blais Moderator with 126 votes.
Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return re-elects Patricia Dow Town Clerk with 127 votes.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Patricia Dow as Halifax town clerk.
Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return re-elects Patricia Dow Town Treasurer with 124 votes.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Patricia Dow as Halifax town treasurer.
Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the elected table seats Mary L. Brewster to 2028 and Patricia Dow to 2027.
Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return re-elects Tina Blais lister with 124 votes.

Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the elected table seats Erin L. Lovern as an auditor to 2027 and shows the other two seats already vacant; the town's Auditors page names Lovern as the town's auditor. Flagged: the March 3, 2026 meeting's Article 6 proposed eliminating the auditor office under 17 V.S.A. section 2651b and its outcome is published in no source read.

Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): both 2026 auditor contests drew no ballot candidate and only scattered write-ins (top counts 3 and 2 against 126 and 122 blanks); a write-in plurality alone does not seat a holder, so both seats are unfilled.
Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return re-elects Mary Brewster Collector of Delinquent Taxes with 126 votes.
Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the elected table seats Steven M. Cohen to 2028 and Laurel A. Copeland to 2027.

Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return re-elects Patrick McAllister a trustee of public funds with 122 votes (the return prints 'Patric').
Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the elected table seats Gary Rand to 2027 and Linda M. Swanson to 2028.
Town of Halifax, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (halifaxvt.com): the certified March 3, 2026 return re-elects Laurel A. Copeland a cemetery commissioner with 126 votes.

Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): constables in Halifax are appointed by the Selectboard (the meeting book's appointments section names Kyle Farnsworth as First Constable for the March 2025 cycle). Structure only: the 2026 appointment is unpublished.

Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the appointments section names Roy Richardson as Second Constable for the March 2025 cycle. Structure only: the 2026 appointment is unpublished.
Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the elected table seats one town-elected Trustee to the Whitingham Library: Mark Halverson, to 2027.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five justices of the peace for Halifax.
Town of Halifax FY2025 Town Meeting Book (halifaxvt.com): the elected table names the same five (printing the fifth as Malcolm K. Sumner).
